info.title: ATRIUM digital-convert API
info.description: Born-digital documents (PDF, DOCX, ODT, ODS, XLSX, RTF, DOC, XLS) into the ATRIUM document record, and a per-page assessment of whether each page's text can be used as it is.

500.description: Processing failed. Report it; do not retry blindly.

503.description: `degraded`: the deep check failed, or the replica drains.

post.description:
Convert a born-digital document into docproc (§4.2; atrium-project#84).

Calls no other service. A page whose text layer cannot be used (it does not decode, it is a
prior OCR run, there is none) carries `needsAtr` with its reason and is routed `atr`; no
document is refused for its pages. No record is written: ocr-postprocess builds it from the
docproc.

post.description:
Convert a born-digital document and assess every page (§4.2). Parked: not part of the
pilot (atrium-project#84, H11).

For each page: whether its text layer can be used, what kind of page it is
(page-classification), whether its text reads (ocr-postprocess), and where it should go
next (`nlp`, `ocr`, `htr`, `none`). A stage that is not configured, not running or answers
badly is reported in `stages[]`; the request still succeeds. The stages are sent the
converter's development dict, which stages on record schema 2.0 may refuse.

200.description: The record, the per-page assessment, and what each adjacent stage did.

file.title: File
file.description: The born-digital document: PDF, DOCX, ODT, ODS, XLSX, RTF, or legacy DOC/XLS (decided by content).

document_json.title: Document Json
document_json.description: Optional: the AMČR seed of the document (`doc_id`, `source` with `sha512`, `filename`, `media_type`), read only. Its `doc_id` names the result; its `sha512` must be the uploaded file's (else 422 `source_digest_mismatch`). Nothing is written into it: since atrium-project#84 the record is built by ocr-postprocess from the docproc. A part that cannot be opened is refused (422 `invalid_record`); an empty part counts as none.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Which adjacent stages to call: a comma-separated subset of `page-classification`, `ocr-postprocess`; empty for every configured one; `none` for none (the assessment then rests on the converter alone).

classify_pages.title: Classify Pages
classify_pages.description: Pages page-classification is asked about: those without a usable text layer and those whose only text is a running header or footer over an image (default), or all.

docx_page_breaks.title: Docx Page Breaks
docx_page_breaks.description: DOCX pages: `auto` (explicit + Word's rendered breaks), `explicit`, or `none` (one page).

@context.title: @Context
@context.description: The JSON-LD context: RO-Crate 1.2, plus the terms ATRIUM adds.

name.title: Name
name.description: A human-readable name of the run.

instrument.title: Instrument
instrument.description: The tool: a `SoftwareApplication` with `version`, its release page as `@id`, its repository as `url` and its authors as `creator`.

containerImage.title: Containerimage
containerImage.description: The image the service ran as (`ATRIUM_RUNNER_IMAGE`): `registry`, `name`, `tag`.

object.title: Object
object.description: The inputs, each by AMČR distribution name (`name`) and SHA-512 (`sha512`): the uploaded file and the record version sent with it. An input that is not stored carries `stored: false` (D23).

result.title: Result
result.description: The outputs, by distribution name and SHA-512. The record's (`atrium/document-json`) names the blocks and fields the call wrote in `recordFields`; an output that is not stored carries `stored: false`.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: The organisation operating the service (`ATRIUM_RUN_AGENT`); absent when it is not set.

paradataRecord.title: Paradatarecord
paradataRecord.description: The run's atrium_paradata record (schema 3.0: no calculated licence), as the tool wrote it.

CreateAction.title: CreateAction
CreateAction.description:
The RO-Crate `CreateAction` of this call: its provenance (atrium-project#71 R2).

One Process Run Crate 0.5 action per call, as nested JSON-LD, built by
`atrium_rocrate.create_action()`; the same document an archive stores as the run's paradata
file. It names the tool as its `instrument` (with `version`, its release page as `@id` and its
authors as `creator`), the image as `containerImage`, the inputs as `object`, what the call
wrote as `result`, the `agent`, `startTime`/`endTime` and `actionStatus`, and the run's whole
paradata record as `paradataRecord`. Every service returns it with a successful response; its
`@id` is the run's `run_uuid`. Since doc-schema-v2 (atrium-project#84) the record carries no
stamps: the `result` names the record blocks AND fields the call wrote, and every input and output
is named by its AMČR distribution name and SHA-512.

doc_id.title: Doc Id
doc_id.description: The document's id: the seed's `doc_id` when one was sent, else derived from the file name.

docproc.title: Docproc
docproc.description: The document's layout as docproc (`atr/docproc-json`, atrium-project#84): pages with the text-layer verdict (`textLayer`) and, where the text cannot be used, `needsAtr` with its reason; blocks with their `lines[]`; `metadata.routing.pages[]` routing every page (`text-layer`, `atr`, `empty`). Valid against `schemas/docproc/document.atrium-proposal.schema.json` (the ATR's schema with asks 3 and 13). No record is written: ocr-postprocess builds it from this.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Only with `markdown=true`: the document rendered as annotated Markdown (json_to_md).

limits_applied.title: Limits Applied
limits_applied.description: The sampling and splitting the result rests on; none for this converter (D13).

paradata.description: The call's provenance (paradata 3.0, atrium-project#84): its Process Run Crate `CreateAction`. `object` is the upload as `original` (and the seed, `atrium/document-json`), `result` the docproc (`atr/docproc-json`), each by SHA-512; the docproc is `stored: false` when a page needs the ATR (H14).

document.title: Document
document.description: The converter's development dict as the stages left it: record-shaped (`pages`, `lines` with `group_id`, `style` and decode `flags`, `content`, `tables`), never a record and never stored.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: One entry per page, in page order.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: One entry per stage, in the order they run.

DescribeResponse.title: DescribeResponse
DescribeResponse.description:
`/describe` (parked): the docproc, the development dict, the per-page assessment and what
each stage did.

reacquire_pages.title: Reacquire Pages
reacquire_pages.description: `page_index` of the pages routed to `ocr` or `htr`.

service.title: Service
service.description: The tool id, which is the repository name.

version.title: Version
version.description: The tool version (`para_config.txt`), as in the release tag without the `v`.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Every limit of the service: `{key: effective value}`.

limits_meta.title: Limits Meta
limits_meta.description: For each limit: the variable that sets it, its unit, default, source.

openapi_sha256.title: Openapi Sha256
openapi_sha256.description: sha256 of this process's OpenAPI document in canonical form, equal to the `openapi.json.sha256` asset of the release the image was built from.

program.title: Program
program.description: The program id the record and paradata carry: `digital-convert`.

supported_inputs.title: Supported Inputs
supported_inputs.description: The file suffixes the converter reads (by content, not by name).

media_types.title: Media Types
media_types.description: The media type of each input kind.

libreoffice.title: Libreoffice
libreoffice.description: Whether DOC/XLS can be converted in this deployment.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: Which adjacent stages `/describe` can call (their URLs are configured).

status.title: Status
status.description: The HTTP status, as an integer.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: A registered reason code, listed with its statuses in the spec's `x-atrium-reason-codes`, or null when no code is registered for the cause. An open string: a release may add a code, but never renames or removes one.

limit.description: Only with `limit_exceeded`: the limit and the input's size.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: The request-validation problems, or a structured detail.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: Only with `unsupported_media_type`: the file extensions or media types the endpoint reads.

cause.title: Cause
cause.description: A finer, unregistered cause (for example a reader's code). Informational; it may change.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: The body of every error a service returns (§4.4).

status.title: Status
status.description: `ok`, or `degraded` (HTTP 503) when the deep check fails or the replica drains.

in_flight.title: In Flight
in_flight.description: Deep check only: requests being served.

draining.title: Draining
draining.description: Deep check only: the replica is shutting down.

HealthBody.title: HealthBody
HealthBody.description: `GET /health`: liveness, and with `?deep=true` a check of the backends.

env.title: Env
env.description: The environment variable that sets it; null for a derived limit.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the current value came from: `env`, `config`, `default` or `derived`.

default.title: Default
default.description: The built-in default (not for a derived limit).

derived_from.title: Derived From
derived_from.description: For a derived limit: the settings it is computed from.

zero_means_unlimited.title: Zero Means Unlimited
zero_means_unlimited.description: True when 0 switches the limit off.

value.title: Value
value.description: The limit's value when it applied.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: What it did: `sampled` or `split`. (`trimmed`, `skipped` and `stopped` fail the request since doc-schema-v2, D13; they appear only in notes written before it.)

LimitNote.title: LimitNote
LimitNote.description:
One limit that shaped a result without refusing it (the paradata `limits`, §4.5).

Since doc-schema-v2 (D13) only sampling and splitting are recorded: a limit that trims, skips
or stops content fails the request instead.

env.title: Env
env.description: The environment variable that sets it; null for a derived limit.

observed.title: Observed
observed.description: What the input measured; null when it is not known exactly.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Only when a limit trimmed, skipped or stopped content during processing (D13): that effect. The step failed; `observed` is the number of units affected.

LimitRef.title: LimitRef
LimitRef.description: Which limit a `limit_exceeded` refusal is about, and by how much.

top.title: Top
top.description: The `topn` categories with scores, best first.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Distinct `group_id`s: paragraphs, table cells, a sheet.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Reading-order columns of the body text (PDF).

vector_paths.title: Vector Paths
vector_paths.description: Vector paths the page draws (PDF): rules, curves, text drawn as outlines.

words.title: Words
words.description: Whitespace-separated words of the page's body text (outside its running header and footer).

damaged_words.title: Damaged Words
damaged_words.description: Of those, the words that lost a letter to a glyph without a Unicode mapping (U+FFFD). Counted for information: they route nothing (atrium-digital-convert#9); whether the text reads is ocr-postprocess's scoring.

PageLayout.title: PageLayout
PageLayout.description: What the converter found on the page.

source.title: Source
source.description: `ocr-postprocess` (the common line-quality model) or `digital-convert` (the decode check only).

score.title: Score
score.description: From 0 to 1. ocr-postprocess: the mean line-quality score of the lines it judged (Clear/Noisy/Trash; a pre-filter answer's 0.0 placeholder is left out). digital-convert: the page's decode sanity (the record's `pages[].quality_score` before any scoring), a measure of how the characters decode, not of how the text reads.

band.title: Band
band.description: `Clear`, `Noisy` or `Trash`; null when no line was judged. ocr-postprocess: the plurality of its line verdicts. digital-convert: the decode-sanity band, so a garbled page can read `Clear` here; `text_layer` and `lines_by_category.Garbage` say whether it decodes.

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: The page's dominant language among the lines the model judged, when it reports one.

lines_scored.title: Lines Scored
lines_scored.description: Lines the verdict is based on. ocr-postprocess: the lines it judged Clear, Noisy or Trash; `Non-text`/`Empty` lines are counted in `lines_by_category` only.

prose_lines_scored.title: Prose Lines Scored
prose_lines_scored.description: ocr-postprocess only: the scored lines that are prose — outside a table, at least 20 characters, mostly letters, not a table-of-contents line. The quality rule of a `digital` page counts only these (`ROUTE_TRASH_SHARE`).

prose_lines_by_category.title: Prose Lines By Category
prose_lines_by_category.description: ocr-postprocess only: `lines_by_category` over the prose lines.

PageQuality.title: PageQuality
PageQuality.description: Whether a page's text reads: the common quality model, or the converter's decode check.

page.title: Page
page.description: The page label (`pages[].page` in the record).

text_layer.title: Text Layer
text_layer.description: `digital` (decodes), `garbled` (exists, does not decode), `ocr` (a prior OCR run), `none` (no text layer, or only a running header or footer over a full-page image), `blank` (an empty page without a page image): the record's `pages[].text_layer`.

category.description: Null when page-classification did not run for the page.

quality.description: Null for a page without lines.

text.title: Text
text.description: The page's text in reading order (unless `include_text=false`).

media_type.title: Media Type
media_type.description: The original's media type (`source.media_type` unless a seed named one).

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: The structural engine: `light` (the only one in the service image).

conversion.title: Conversion
conversion.description: DOC/XLS only: how LibreOffice converted the original (`tool`, `from`, `to`, `seconds`); else null.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Reader notes worth knowing (e.g. a conversion); usually empty.

doc_id.title: Doc Id
doc_id.description: The document's id: the seed's `doc_id` when one was sent, else derived from the file name.

docproc.title: Docproc
docproc.description: The document's layout as docproc (`atr/docproc-json`, atrium-project#84): pages with the text-layer verdict (`textLayer`) and, where the text cannot be used, `needsAtr` with its reason; blocks with their `lines[]`; `metadata.routing.pages[]` routing every page (`text-layer`, `atr`, `empty`). Valid against `schemas/docproc/document.atrium-proposal.schema.json` (the ATR's schema with asks 3 and 13). No record is written: ocr-postprocess builds it from this.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Only with `markdown=true`: the document rendered as annotated Markdown (json_to_md).

limits_applied.title: Limits Applied
limits_applied.description: The sampling and splitting the result rests on; none for this converter (D13).

paradata.description: The call's provenance (paradata 3.0, atrium-project#84): its Process Run Crate `CreateAction`. `object` is the upload as `original` (and the seed, `atrium/document-json`), `result` the docproc (`atr/docproc-json`), each by SHA-512; the docproc is `stored: false` when a page needs the ATR (H14).

ReformatResponse.title: ReformatResponse
ReformatResponse.description: `/reformat`: the document's layout as docproc, and its Markdown when asked for.

url.title: Url
url.description: The stage's base URL; null when not configured.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The stage's reason code, or the guard's (`page_key_mismatch`, ...).

record_adopted.title: Record Adopted
record_adopted.description: Whether the stage's write was taken into `document` (the development dict).

paradata.title: Paradata
paradata.description: The stage's own `CreateAction`, when it returned one.

lines_unscored.title: Lines Unscored
lines_unscored.description: ocr-postprocess: lines it could not score (out of GPU memory even one at a time; its `limits_applied` `ppl_batch_lines`). They keep the converter's values in the record and are left out of the report; the stage is then `partial`.

limit_exceeded.description: The input is over one of the service's limits. The body's `limit` member names it (`key`, the environment variable `env` that sets it, `value`, `observed`, `unit`). HTTP 413 when the request content is too large, 422 when a parameter or a per-input processing budget is exceeded, 504 when a time limit that depends on an upstream service expired. Split the input, or raise the limit.

busy.description: Every processing slot or queue place is taken (HTTP 429). Retry after the `Retry-After` header's number of seconds.

unsupported_media_type.description: The upload is not a type this endpoint reads (HTTP 415). `detail` says what was sent; the body's `accepted` member lists the file extensions or media types the endpoint accepts, and `cause` may name a finer, unregistered reason. Convert the input or send it to the tool that reads it; do not retry it unchanged.

invalid_record.description: The document record sent with the request cannot be opened (HTTP 422): it is not UTF-8 JSON, not a JSON object, or its `schema_version` has a newer major than this tool reads. Also sent when a block the tool adds rows to (`pages`, `lines`, `entities`) is not a list of objects. A record that opens but does not validate against the schema is otherwise accepted and reported in `document_json_schema_error`. Fix the record; do not retry it unchanged.

ocr_text_layer.description: DEPRECATED since doc-schema-v2 (atrium-project#84, H12): no service sends it. It meant: the PDF's text layer is an earlier OCR run's invisible text over page images (HTTP 422). Such pages are now marked `needs_atr` in docproc's routing, and the document goes through the ATR.

source_digest_mismatch.description: The record sent with the request names the original by its `source.sha512`, and the uploaded file is not that file (HTTP 422): the record would describe one file under another file's identity. Send the original the seed was made for, or a seed made for this file; do not retry unchanged.

upstream_unavailable.description: A backing service the tool calls (named at the start of `detail`, e.g. LINDAT UDPipe) did not answer after the tool's own retries (HTTP 502): it returned a server error, or refused or dropped the connection. The input is not at fault. Retry later with backoff. A backing service that timed out is a 504 `limit_exceeded` instead.
